name: intelligence-monitor-desktop
description: Intelligence Monitor desktop shell - Electron wrapper for the Python FastAPI server

scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:server-sidecar && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:server-sidecar && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:server-sidecar && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:current: npm run build && npm run build:server-sidecar && electron-builder --publish never
